extracted.name: Wasabi Mayonnaise Sauce
extracted.description: This wasabi sauce is great on grilled salmon and other fish. It's quick and easy to make with just three ingredients: wasabi powder, water, and mayonnaise.
instruction_lines: Mix wasabi powder and water together in a small bowl to form a paste. Let sit for 1 minute, then stir in mayonnaise.
